statusDefinitions.base: Mature starting-world technology or a later derivative/revival of that baseline family. Base does not mean obsolete or primitive.
statusDefinitions.existing: Already expected or established by the current Star Cluster Concept/accepted architecture. Story placement may still be refined before numerical table work.
statusDefinitions.candidate: A strong proposed addition with a coherent scientific/engineering premise and gameplay role. Candidate is not yet an adopted component or numerical TL-table entry.
statusDefinitions.deferred: Worth preserving, but the owning family, era, prerequisites, gameplay role, or implementation cost is not settled enough for promotion.
statusDefinitions.exotic: Precursor-grade, rule-bending, deliberately extreme weird science, or technology otherwise outside the normal player-developed TL1-TL9 ladder.

structuralRoleDefinitions.core_family: Primary lineage normally represented by a standard/base component family.
structuralRoleDefinitions.maturation: Improves integration, efficiency, reliability, packaging, resilience, or a bounded operating property without changing the core principle.
structuralRoleDefinitions.branch: A specialist or alternate lineage that coexists with the main family rather than automatically replacing it.
structuralRoleDefinitions.cross_pollinated_derivative: An owning-tree technology unlocked or transformed by a genuinely enabling external research discipline.
structuralRoleDefinitions.legacy_revival: A mature older family becomes strategically interesting again because later science enables a new niche or performance envelope.
structuralRoleDefinitions.operating_capability: A mode or capability applied to an existing family rather than a new hardware family.
structuralRoleDefinitions.specialist_auxiliary: A support installation that creates a meaningful design choice without becoming a new visible research tree.
structuralRoleDefinitions.one_off: A useful technology that may have no natural multi-TL progression and does not need a successor merely to fill a cell.
structuralRoleDefinitions.infrastructure: A strategic/site technology rather than an ordinary player-cruiser component.
structuralRoleDefinitions.campaign_technology: A technology whose principal value is exploration, logistics, salvage, diplomacy, or campaign consequence rather than direct combat.
structuralRoleDefinitions.weird_science: A speculative but potentially normal-player scientific concept that can exist as a one-off or rare branch without becoming Precursor magic.
structuralRoleDefinitions.precursor_artifact: Non-player-developed Precursor technology or artifact behavior; TL10 is shorthand only.

eraTone.label: Slightly Futuristic Baseline
eraTone.tone: Highly mature late-near-future engineering plus the few setting-defining breakthroughs needed for Star Cluster, especially practical FTL and baseline defensive fields. TL1 should feel sophisticated rather than primitive.

eraTone.label: Lower-SF Introduction
eraTone.tone: First broadly practical post-baseline breakthroughs. New principles may be awkward, bulky, power-hungry, or incomplete.

eraTone.label: Lower-SF Integration
eraTone.tone: Many early breakthroughs become shipworthy, integrated, compact, reliable, or tactically flexible. TL3 is not a universal maturation tier; this is only a broad era tone.

eraTone.label: Mature Lower-SF
eraTone.tone: Lower-SF families reach strong practical forms and begin creating new subsystem architectures rather than only scalar improvements.

eraTone.label: Early Higher-SF
eraTone.tone: Technologies with severe real-world engineering barriers become credible player tools; mature lower-SF families may receive peak or specialist revivals.

eraTone.label: Integrated Higher-SF
eraTone.tone: Advanced materials, computation, field control, autonomous engineering, particle technologies, and antimatter-class systems become more routinely integrated.

eraTone.label: Mature Higher-SF
eraTone.tone: High-energy and highly automated systems reach strong operational forms. Weird-science side branches may appear, but should still have explicit costs and counters.

eraTone.label: Early Science-Fantasy Edge
eraTone.tone: Player science begins manipulating matter, fields, signatures, inertia, and spacetime in ways that are deliberately beyond conservative engineering extrapolation.

eraTone.label: Player-Technological Pinnacle
eraTone.tone: The normal player ladder reaches its strongest coherent science-fantasy forms. TL9 should be campaign-defining but remain bounded and distinct from Precursor rule-breaking.

principles: Technology families tell their own development story; no family is forced to populate every TL or follow identical breakpoints.
TL1 is a highly mature slightly futuristic baseline, except for deliberate setting miracles such as practical FTL and baseline shields.
TL2-4 broadly feel like lower science fiction, TL5-7 higher science fiction, and TL8-9 increasingly science fantasy; these are tonal guides, not hard gates.
New families should move at least one useful capability/design frontier; mature legacy technologies may remain competitive through a real niche.
An older family may receive a later revival when its owning field or an enabling external field creates a genuinely new derivative.
Cross-pollination is sparse and causal. The owning research category remains explicit and external prerequisites are limited to genuinely enabling science.
One-off and weird-science technologies are allowed. A concept does not need a multi-TL sequel to deserve preservation.
Precursor/TL10 is shorthand only and remains outside normal player-developed TL1-TL9 research.
This storyboard is conceptual architecture, not a numerical component table or automatic unlock list.

disciplines.name: Hull
disciplines.story: Hull research is the engineering of a persistent cruiser lineage: structure, compartmentation, maintainability, integration and bounded capacity. It should not become automatic ship-class escalation.

lineages.name: Cruiser Structural Integration
lineages.identity: A bounded cruiser platform whose main progression is better use of volume, load paths, service routing, survivability and integration rather than unlimited Hull Points or giant size.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: TL1 narrative should be more advanced than the current shorthand “rolled-alloy era.” TL3 integration is consistent with accepted numbers; no numeric change is made here.

beats.title: Mature aerospace/composite cruiser construction
beats.story: Late-near-future alloys, ceramics, composites, embedded diagnostics, mature compartmentation and robust service trunks define the normal player cruiser. Baseline shielding/FTL are setting breakthroughs layered onto an otherwise comprehensible hull.

beats.title: Distributed structural monitoring and modular service architecture
beats.story: Improved embedded sensing, modular access and standardized high-energy service interfaces make repairs/refits cleaner without requiring more hull size.

beats.title: Integrated cruiser architecture
beats.story: The accepted TL3 +1 Installation-Space direction fits a structural-integration story: better routing, packaging and compartment use rather than a universal durability increase.

beats.title: Nanostructured load-bearing frame
beats.story: Advanced carbon structures/superalloys improve specific strength and high-temperature service integration, enabling better packaging and damage tolerance.

beats.title: Atomically engineered structural composites
beats.story: Designed material gradients, high-temperature joints and resilient laminates support high-energy systems without simply enlarging the cruiser.

beats.title: Self-monitoring smart lattice
beats.story: Structural members participate in continuous load sensing and damage isolation; automated repair systems can stabilize rather than freely regenerate serious damage.

beats.title: Active load-distribution structure
beats.story: High-SF structural control actively redistributes stress and isolates shocks, creating better tolerance for extreme propulsion/weapon loads.

beats.title: Field-assisted structural support
beats.story: Local field effects help support extreme accelerations, impacts or internal load paths. Treat as bounded support, not immunity to damage.

beats.title: Dynamic programmable cruiser architecture
beats.story: A pinnacle player hull can re-route services and locally reconfigure material/field support, improving adaptation and repair while remaining the same cruiser lineage.

lineages.name: Maintainability and Damage Control
lineages.identity: A support lineage covering access, diagnostics, isolation, robotics, fabrication and bounded self-repair. Combat Damage Control remains distinct from post-combat reconstruction.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Current Damage Control rules already support this lineage. Higher-TL story should use existing conditions/Repair Kits rather than a second repair engine.

beats.title: Expert crew, distributed spares and diagnostic access
beats.story: Human maintainers, standardized lockers, remote isolation and mature diagnostics underpin ordinary Damage Control.

beats.title: Predictive diagnostics and better service distribution
beats.story: Improved condition monitoring and maintainability reduce the engineering burden of complex systems without adding a new repair currency.

beats.title: Remote repair robotics
beats.story: Robotic manipulators and autonomous inspection can perform dangerous work while preserving existing Repair Kit/condition abstractions.

beats.title: Onboard fabrication-assisted repair
beats.story: Compact fabrication can replace selected damaged parts from broad resources; it is a support choice, not free restoration.

beats.title: Autonomous repair swarm
beats.story: Coordinated micro/robotic repair can stabilize multiple faults or improve repair efficiency, bounded by material/energy and condition limits.

beats.title: Self-healing structural materials
beats.story: Engineered materials can close small cracks and restore limited integrity between severe events; destroyed components still require replacement.

beats.title: Programmable matter repair patches
beats.story: High-end matter control produces configurable structural patches and interfaces; use as bounded repair acceleration, not resurrection.

beats.title: Autonomous reconstruction architecture
beats.story: Pinnacle player maintainability can reconfigure stored matter and robotic systems to rebuild complex assemblies over appropriate campaign time, while still consuming resources.

lineages.name: Habitation and Gravity Architecture
lineages.identity: Mostly narrative/architectural support. Spin or acceleration gravity may remain a mature baseline; generated gravity is a later architectural breakthrough, not a mandatory combat stat.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: No gravity technology is currently needed for the accepted combat model. Capture it now as architectural worldbuilding/cross-pollination.

beats.title: Spin/acceleration gravity and mature long-duration habitation
beats.story: Conventional artificial-gravity architecture and medical countermeasures support extended missions.

beats.title: Compact/stowable gravity habitats
beats.story: Improved structural and control systems reduce the burden of rotating habitats while preserving them as rugged legacy architecture.

beats.title: Generated local gravity
beats.story: A genuine higher-SF breakthrough may replace rotation in selected spaces, changing ship architecture more than combat arithmetic.

beats.title: Inertial-comfort field
beats.story: Field control may protect crew/equipment from extreme acceleration. Keep separate from tactical evasion until a clear gameplay role exists.

disciplines.name: Armor
disciplines.story: Armor remains passive material protection first. Later branches may add ablative, reactive, energized or self-healing behavior without making every armor generation a universal AP/AI increase.

lineages.name: Passive Armor Materials
lineages.identity: Layered protection whose identity comes from material architecture, Integrity and Protection rather than a single escalating resistance value.

beats.title: Advanced alloy/ceramic composite armor
beats.story: TL1 should read as slightly futuristic aerospace/warship armor, not literal industrial-era rolled plate. The accepted mechanics can remain unchanged while the narrative baseline is modernized.

beats.title: Toughened ceramic-composite laminate
beats.story: The accepted TL2 Integrity maturation fits improved fracture control and laminate design.

beats.title: Protected layered composite
beats.story: The accepted AP1/AI5 direction fits stronger layering/material interfaces without requiring a new armor family.

beats.title: Nanostructured armor matrix
beats.story: Carbon nanostructures and atomically engineered alloys improve specific strength and thermal/radiation tolerance.

beats.title: Gradient/diamondoid composite armor
beats.story: Designed material gradients and extremely strong covalent structures create more efficient passive protection.

beats.title: Self-healing smart laminate
beats.story: Damage-tolerant material can restore limited integrity or improve repairability after combat rather than negate incoming damage.

beats.title: Active reactive armor architecture
beats.story: Embedded sensors and powered elements may respond to impact or beam deposition. This is a specialist armor enhancement, not automatic passive armor behavior.

beats.title: Field-assisted armor
beats.story: A high-end material/field composite redistributes stress or energy before it reaches the passive layer. Keep penetrations/counters explicit.

beats.title: Programmable matter armor
beats.story: Pinnacle armor dynamically optimizes local material structure and can regain limited Integrity through controlled reconfiguration.

lineages.name: Armor Enhancement Branches
lineages.identity: Optional external/auxiliary defensive layers that create distinct tradeoffs rather than replacing primary armor.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Do not turn every later armor improvement into another universal layer. Specialist counters should remain optional and causal.

beats.title: Ablative outer layer
beats.story: Expendable outer armor remains a simple optional layer with its own AP/AI.

beats.title: Thermal/radiation hardening package
beats.story: Specialist protection counters ionizing/particle or high-temperature effects without creating a universal resistance stat.

beats.title: Powered reactive armor
beats.story: A powered armor auxiliary may alter one specific damage/penetration interaction at Tactical Power cost.

beats.title: Electromagnetic particle screen
beats.story: A specialized energized layer may counter charged-particle/ion weapons while doing little against other threats.

disciplines.name: Power
disciplines.story: Power is the clearest overlapping-family model: mature fission at TL1; Fusion begins at TL2 and matures through TL4; Antimatter begins at TL5 and matures through TL7; direct matter conversion appears at TL8-9. Older sources may revive as specialist branches.

lineages.name: Main Reactor Generation
lineages.identity: Sustained Tactical Power generation. Output, footprint, reliability, damaged output, overload, conversion efficiency, containment and enabling science are independent axes.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: CP105 flags a story mismatch at TL2: the current mechanical candidate behaves mostly like improved TL1 output. Later table work should make Early Fusion read as a distinct family without invalidating accepted CP104 numbers by default.

beats.title: Peak Fission
beats.story: Highly mature fission provides the dependable starting reactor. It is not obsolete merely because Fusion appears.

beats.title: Early Practical Fusion
beats.story: The first viable shipboard Fusion family appears. It should eventually have a recognizable operating/design promise beyond being “Reactor 2,” even if the accepted provisional numeric seed is retained until later table work.

beats.title: Mature Compact Fusion
beats.story: Fusion integration/packaging improves; the accepted 6-TP/5-Space direction already fits this story.

beats.title: High-Output Fusion
beats.story: Mature Fusion pushes the usable output frontier or delivers another genuinely output-related improvement.

beats.title: Early Antimatter / Peak Fusion coexistence
beats.story: Antimatter becomes a new high-energy family with severe containment/production burdens while a highly mature Fusion option remains strategically relevant.

beats.title: Mature Antimatter
beats.story: Containment, conditioning, integration and reliability make Antimatter practical enough for regular high-end warships.

beats.title: High-Output Antimatter
beats.story: Antimatter reaches its strong player-developed performance form, with containment still a defining engineering identity.

beats.title: Fractional/Direct Matter Conversion / Peak Antimatter coexistence
beats.story: Limited direct conversion of ordinary feedstock begins; Antimatter remains a mature alternative with known containment/logistics behavior.

beats.title: Total Matter Conversion
beats.story: The normal player power ladder reaches its pinnacle: controlled conversion of ordinary matter to usable energy, bounded by component architecture and game balance rather than infinite power.

lineages.name: Late Fission Specialist Revival
lineages.identity: A deliberate example of the rule that old technology may become interesting again through new materials/conversion methods.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: This lineage is intentionally sparse. It demonstrates legacy revival without forcing a fission entry at every TL.

beats.title: Direct-conversion / advanced-containment fission specialist
beats.story: Later materials, high-temperature conversion and reactor engineering may produce an exceptionally rugged, low-maintenance, damage-tolerant or low-signature fission reactor even after Fusion is dominant. It need not beat contemporary Antimatter on raw output.

beats.title: Pinnacle fission expedition/auxiliary reactor
beats.story: A mature fission derivative could remain attractive for long endurance, independent fuel logistics, benign failure modes or infrastructure duty. Keep as a niche, not a mandatory ladder step.

lineages.name: Pulse Storage and Power Conditioning
lineages.identity: Storage handles peak demand and temporal mismatch rather than replacing sustained reactor generation.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Keep storage as Aux/support choices unless a genuine whole-ship architecture requires otherwise.

beats.title: High-density battery / pulse capacitor
beats.story: A compact energy store can support emergency power or burst loads within existing Tactical Power rules.

beats.title: Supercapacitor bank
beats.story: Nanostructured capacitors combine rapid charge/discharge with useful capacity, especially for burst weapons/shields.

beats.title: Superconducting magnetic storage
beats.story: Advanced superconductors enable high-rate storage and low-loss power conditioning.

beats.title: Molecular dielectric ultracapacitor
beats.story: Atomically engineered storage improves density/retention and pulse delivery without changing main-reactor output.

beats.title: Field-energy reservoir
beats.story: A high-end field system may store/release large energy pulses. Require explicit finite capacity and failure consequences if adopted.

lineages.name: Thermal Management and Energy Conversion
lineages.identity: Normally hidden inside component Space/performance. Explicit thermal technologies appear only when they create a meaningful choice such as suppression, compactness or enabling a demanding family.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Thermal remains support architecture, not a new visible research tree.

beats.title: Heat pipes, coolant loops, radiators and phase-change reserves
beats.story: Ordinary thermal engineering is part of component footprints rather than a universal heat meter.

beats.title: High-temperature compact radiators
beats.story: Improved materials permit smaller/hotter thermal systems with power/vulnerability tradeoffs.

beats.title: Droplet/mist radiator architecture
beats.story: Advanced radiator forms can reduce mass/area for selected ships or installations. Treat as integration/Space support, not a new tactical bar.

beats.title: Retractable thermal suppression
beats.story: A ship may temporarily reduce exposed thermal signature by storing heat, with finite duration/Strain/activation limits rather than a continuous heat simulation.

beats.title: Direct energy recovery / advanced heat pumping
beats.story: More waste energy is recovered or shifted, supporting high-energy systems and lower signatures.

beats.title: Entropy-routing field
beats.story: Science-fantasy thermal control could temporarily move/store waste entropy in a bounded way. Keep far short of “no waste heat.”

disciplines.name: Propulsion
disciplines.story: One visible research discipline owns two distinct installed families: STL and FTL. Their technology stories may cross-pollinate with Power but retain separate components and gameplay identities.

lineages.name: Sublight Propulsion
lineages.identity: Tactical/system maneuver. The story should preserve thrust/efficiency/endurance/overload distinctions while keeping movement rules KISS.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Current TL1-TL3 mechanics are generic movement values; CP105 flags the need for explicit operating-principle names/identity in later table work.

beats.title: High-power electric/plasma cruiser drive
beats.story: A slightly futuristic high-power electromagnetic/plasma system provides the normal STL baseline. Nuclear-electric and electric propulsion provide grounded inspiration for efficient in-space thrust, while Star Cluster abstracts actual acceleration into Move.

beats.title: Pulsed high-energy plasma drive
beats.story: Better field control and power electronics increase useful tactical thrust without changing the research family into “Fusion Drive” automatically.

beats.title: Fusion-assisted torch / mature high-energy STL
beats.story: The accepted Move3 direction can be narrated as Propulsion exploiting mature Fusion-era power/containment, while Propulsion remains the owning tree.

beats.title: Mature fusion torch architecture
beats.story: Lower-SF propulsion reaches a high-thrust/high-endurance form and better bounded overload behavior.

beats.title: Antimatter-catalyzed fusion drive
beats.story: Tiny antimatter quantities catalyze a mature fusion/plasma system, bridging families without requiring a full antimatter main drive.

beats.title: Antimatter plasma drive
beats.story: Mature containment supports a direct high-energy antimatter/plasma propulsion family.

beats.title: Beam-core / ultra-high-energy propulsion
beats.story: Higher-SF antimatter propulsion emphasizes extreme output and integration burden rather than free movement.

beats.title: Inertial-coupled drive
beats.story: Field manipulation begins reducing inertial/structural limits. Keep acceleration, fuel and tactical response costs explicit.

beats.title: Gravitic/metric sublight drive
beats.story: Pinnacle player STL manipulates local fields/spacetime for maneuver without becoming teleportation. Tactical hex movement and initiative still apply.

lineages.name: Specialist Sublight Drives
lineages.identity: Branches useful for probes, infrastructure or niche ships. They illustrate that “best” propulsion depends on mission.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Specialist drives need not occupy the base cruiser ladder.

beats.title: Solar/nuclear electric endurance drive
beats.story: Very efficient low-thrust drives remain excellent for probes/logistics even if inappropriate for tactical cruiser maneuver.

beats.title: Nuclear thermal sprint drive
beats.story: A fission thermal branch can trade propellant efficiency and reactor integration for higher thrust. It may be infrastructure/mission tech rather than the player cruiser default.

beats.title: Fission pulse expedition drive
beats.story: Advanced structures/materials could make pulsed fission propulsion a rugged specialist option.

lineages.name: Strategic FTL Drive
lineages.identity: Cluster-map transit. FTL is a deliberate setting miracle available at TL1; progression should preserve unknown-space exploration, route knowledge and strandedness rather than erase the map.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: FTL remains separate from STL despite shared Propulsion research. Do not let high TL erase unknown-sector stops or exploration stakes without an explicit future decision.

beats.title: First-generation practical FTL
beats.story: FTL is the setting-defining exception to the otherwise slightly futuristic TL1 tone. Its exact fictional physics can remain deliberately broad until lore requires a stronger commitment.

beats.title: Stabilized FTL transit
beats.story: Reliability/navigation and known-space speed improve while unknown-sector entry still interrupts movement.

beats.title: Integrated FTL navigation
beats.story: The accepted Move3 strategic direction represents faster known-space transit without defeating exploration geography.

beats.title: High-throughput FTL field
beats.story: Mature lower-SF FTL improves route efficiency, recovery and hazard tolerance rather than simply multiplying range.

beats.title: Adaptive transition geometry
beats.story: Higher-SF FTL can better handle difficult stars/regions or emergency rerouting, with explicit map-level costs.

beats.title: Deep-route FTL navigation
beats.story: Advanced sensing/computation reduces uncertainty and supports more ambitious route planning without making unknown space fully known.

beats.title: Resilient high-energy FTL
beats.story: A mature higher-SF drive tolerates disruptions and improves recovery/operating envelope; routine tactical micro-jumps remain deferred.

beats.title: Metric-transition FTL
beats.story: Player science begins explicit spacetime engineering. This can alter strategic constraints but should not become arbitrary teleportation.

beats.title: Pinnacle topology-control FTL
beats.story: The strongest normal player FTL may shape routes/transition conditions in bounded ways while preserving sector geography and campaign decisions.

lineages.name: Transit Infrastructure and Natural/Artificial Routes
lineages.identity: Strategic infrastructure that changes sector topology without replacing the onboard FTL ladder.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: TL10 here is shorthand only; Precursor routes are not player research.

beats.title: Mapped natural shortcuts / stable anomalies
beats.story: Sensors/Exploration can reveal persistent routes that low-TL ships may exploit.

beats.title: Player-built transit anchor
beats.story: A mature civilization might stabilize or service fixed route nodes. This is infrastructure, not a cruiser upgrade.

beats.title: Limited player-built gate network
beats.story: Pinnacle player science may construct rare fixed links under strict constraints; evaluate only when sector-economy/logistics systems warrant it.

beats.title: Precursor gate / one-way conduit / impossible shortcut
beats.story: A Precursor route artifact may explicitly break one normal FTL rule because the exception itself is discoverable content.

disciplines.name: Sensors / EW
disciplines.story: Information technology is an ecology: sensing, ECM, ECCM, emissions, signatures and identification interact but do not collapse into one rating. Higher TL should add modalities, robustness, deception and cooperation rather than only range.

lineages.name: Sensor Suite
lineages.identity: Multimodal passive/active sensing that creates observer-specific track quality and identification. Physical reach and attack eligibility remain separate.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Current TL1-TL3 sensor progression already fits the family-story approach well.

beats.title: Integrated multimodal sensor suite
beats.story: Passive and active optical/radar/thermal/electronic sensing support navigation, search and weapons-quality tracking.

beats.title: Improved discrimination resistance
beats.story: The accepted DR1 direction represents better classification/filtering under EW rather than simple range escalation.

beats.title: Dual normal active modes
beats.story: The accepted Low/High Active modes are a qualitative integration step with real Tactical Power choice.

beats.title: Multimodal fusion and cooperative apertures
beats.story: Advanced processing combines channels, rapid beam steering and shared observations while preserving provenance.

beats.title: Low-probability active sensing / adaptive waveform suite
beats.story: Sensors trade emission conspicuousness, power and discrimination rather than simply becoming invisible.

beats.title: Quantum-limited / precision field sensors
beats.story: Higher-SF detectors improve weak-signal discrimination and navigation; avoid claims of magical omniscience.
references: TI Quantum Computing as enabling inspiration

beats.title: Penetrating particle/gravity-gradient sensing
beats.story: Specialist channels may detect targets/hazards through conditions that defeat conventional modalities, with dedicated costs/counters.

beats.title: Spacetime/FTL-wake sensing
beats.story: Science-fantasy sensors detect metric disturbances, transit wakes or field signatures; they do not automatically identify every ship.

beats.title: Causal-consistency sensor fusion
beats.story: Pinnacle processing/field sensing may infer hidden states from subtle correlations. Keep bounded by observer-safe information rules; no precognition.

lineages.name: Electronic Countermeasures
lineages.identity: Active deception, noise, signature manipulation and track attack. Higher TL should diversify methods/costs instead of stacking unlimited rating.

beats.title: Conventional noise/deception ECM
beats.story: Baseline ECM attacks discrimination at Tactical Power cost.

beats.title: High-strength conventional ECM
beats.story: The accepted rating-2 ceiling increases pressure but remains non-additive across duplicate suites.

beats.title: Efficient full-strength ECM
beats.story: The accepted TL3 efficiency step reduces Tactical Power burden without raising rating.

beats.title: Digital deception / false-track synthesis
beats.story: ECM can attack track provenance/identification with bounded ghost/deception behavior rather than only a larger number.

beats.title: Adaptive cognitive EW
beats.story: Processing adapts jamming/deception to observed sensor behavior within information parity.

beats.title: Distributed cooperative EW
beats.story: Multiple allied emitters coordinate without simply adding local ratings; cooperative effects remain capped.

beats.title: Emitter-targeted electronic attack
beats.story: Specialized systems attack active sensor/datalink behavior or force hard choices rather than universally suppressing everything.

beats.title: Field/signature spoofing
beats.story: High-end emitters imitate exotic propulsion/shield signatures or distort apparent motion, with specialist counters.

beats.title: Metric-spectrum deception
beats.story: Pinnacle EW may manipulate spacetime/field observables, but should never erase all information states by default.

lineages.name: Electronic Counter-Countermeasures
lineages.identity: Counter-deception, fusion, validation and robust tracking. It should not become “ECM but positive.”

beats.title: Conventional filtering and emitter analysis
beats.story: Baseline ECCM restores discrimination against ordinary ECM.

beats.title: High-strength conventional ECCM
beats.story: The accepted rating-2 ceiling counters stronger conventional jamming at real power cost.

beats.title: Efficient full-strength ECCM
beats.story: The accepted TL3 efficiency step reduces cost without automatically raising sensor range.

beats.title: Sensor-fusion anti-deception
beats.story: Cross-checking multiple modalities makes false tracks harder while preserving uncertainty where all channels are weak.

beats.title: Adaptive classifier / signature memory
beats.story: Advanced processing learns opponent deception patterns during observed combat without reading hidden ratings.

beats.title: Cooperative track validation
beats.story: Allied observations can validate or reject deception with explicit provenance and bounded networking.

beats.title: Counter-emitter localization
beats.story: ECCM can turn hostile active emissions into localization/targeting opportunities for specialist weapons.

beats.title: Exotic-channel correlation
beats.story: Metric/particle channels help reject advanced signature manipulation, at high cost and limited coverage.

beats.title: Causal truthing
beats.story: Pinnacle validation may compare many field histories to expose impossible spoofing. Keep it probabilistic/bounded, not omniscient.

lineages.name: Signature Management and Stealth
lineages.identity: A potential branch covering passive design, quiet operation and bounded active concealment. It is not currently a standard TL table stream.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Keep ordinary passive signature management distinct from a future active cloak.

beats.title: Passive low-observability design
beats.story: Geometry, emissions discipline and ordinary thermal management can reduce observability without creating invisibility.

beats.title: Emission-controlled operating posture
beats.story: Ships may accept reduced active systems/performance for a quieter signature state.

beats.title: Thermal suppression window
beats.story: Retractable/thermal-storage architecture creates a finite quiet window with explicit limits.

beats.title: Active signature cancellation
beats.story: Adaptive emissions can cancel or reshape specific signatures, but should be channel-limited and power-hungry.

beats.title: Powered concealment field
beats.story: An active cloak-like system could be a rare high-end Powered installation with incompatibilities and no guaranteed total invisibility.

beats.title: Precursor phase cloak
beats.story: A Precursor device may break ordinary observability rules under explicit constraints.

disciplines.name: Computing / Fire Control
disciplines.story: Computing progression should improve targeting, information fusion, automation, coordination and resilience. New computational principles can be qualitative breakthroughs without granting hidden-information access.

lineages.name: Tactical Computer and Fire Control
lineages.identity: Shipwide fire-control, targeting, report fusion, initiative support and bounded automation. Player/AI information parity remains absolute.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Current TL1-TL3 story is coherent. Higher levels should emphasize architecture/automation rather than universal percentage bonuses.

beats.title: Integrated electronic fire control
beats.story: Mature electronic/optical computing supports ordinary targeting, datalinks and ship control.

beats.title: Refined conventional fire control
beats.story: The accepted targeting improvement fits better estimation and processing rather than a new computer principle.

beats.title: Mature integrated fire control / Evasive Compensation
beats.story: The accepted EvComp capability is a good example of qualitative integration rather than raw accuracy inflation.

beats.title: Photonic/optical combat computing
beats.story: Optical interconnect/processing offers a recognizable lower-SF architectural change in throughput and efficiency.

beats.title: Adaptive AI battle manager
beats.story: Machine reasoning supports multi-target prioritization, damage prediction and doctrine execution while obeying player-information parity.

beats.title: Distributed resilient combat cloud
beats.story: Ship subsystems and allied assets share processing/track tasks with graceful degradation and provenance.

beats.title: Quantum-assisted optimization
beats.story: Quantum/advanced computation accelerates selected optimization/simulation tasks; it is not magical general intelligence.

beats.title: Predictive battle-state synthesis
beats.story: High-SF computing runs massive counterfactual models to improve timing/coordination. No peeking at hidden enemy state.

beats.title: Pinnacle causal modeling computer
beats.story: The normal player pinnacle may exploit exotic computation/field sensors to make exceptionally strong probabilistic predictions, still not literal precognition.

lineages.name: Autonomy, Networking and Digital Crew
lineages.identity: Cross-pollinated applications of computing rather than a separate visible research tree.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Keep sentience separate from raw computing power.

beats.title: Advanced ship automation
beats.story: Automation reduces routine crew burden and supports damage control/sensors.

beats.title: Autonomous specialist agents
beats.story: Bounded AI agents support damage control, EW, logistics and tactical planning without replacing officers or subsystems.

beats.title: Distributed autonomous mission control
beats.story: Long-duration probes/expeditions can operate with greater independence while retaining meaningful failure/recovery risk.

beats.title: Synthetic crew core
beats.story: A high-end digital crew/sentient ship computer may be possible, but narrative/crew consequences need deliberate design first.

disciplines.name: Shields
disciplines.story: Shields are another setting-defining TL1 breakthrough. Progression should separate capacity, recharge, hardening, geometry, efficiency and specialized countermeasures rather than bundle them.

lineages.name: Defensive Field Generator
lineages.identity: Renewable defensive field capacity. The exact fictional physics may remain broad; gameplay identity is renewable protection with explicit penetration/counterplay.

beats.title: Baseline defensive field
beats.story: A practical field generator is one of Star Cluster’s intentional TL1 “miracles.” It provides renewable capacity but no universal Shield Protection.

beats.title: Higher-capacity field
beats.story: The accepted TL2 Capacity increase is straightforward field-strength maturation.

beats.title: Mature field with optional hardening
beats.story: The accepted TL3 Hardener unlock separates capacity from Protection and preserves SPEN counterplay.

beats.title: Segmented/adaptive field geometry
beats.story: Mature lower-SF fields can concentrate protection or isolate damaged sectors with meaningful power/coverage tradeoffs.

beats.title: Frequency/phase-tuned shielding
beats.story: Advanced field control can specialize against selected beam/particle interactions rather than raising universal defense.

beats.title: Predictive localized reinforcement
beats.story: Fire-control prediction dynamically reinforces likely impact regions, trading Tactical Power/coverage.

beats.title: Stand-off shear field
beats.story: A higher-SF field begins deflecting or disrupting attacks before contact; keep damage/penetration relationships explicit.

beats.title: Metric barrier field
beats.story: Science-fantasy shielding manipulates local spacetime/fields to alter incoming trajectories/energy. It still has finite capacity and counters.

beats.title: Pinnacle adaptive barrier
beats.story: The strongest normal player shield combines dynamic geometry and material/field interaction while remaining destructible and power-limited.

lineages.name: Shield Support and Specialist Fields
lineages.identity: Auxiliary technologies that modify field behavior without becoming another universal shield layer.

beats.title: Shield Battery / Booster concepts
beats.story: Finite emergency recharge and capacity support remain distinct roles.

beats.title: Shield Hardener
beats.story: Powered Protection against shield-facing damage is an explicit optional component.

beats.title: Particle/charged-beam screen
beats.story: A specialist electromagnetic/plasma-like field may counter charged particle beams more effectively than ordinary attacks.

beats.title: Field stabilizer / anti-penetration tuner
beats.story: A dedicated support component trades power/Space for better resistance to a narrow penetration class.

beats.title: Precursor stasis/phase barrier
beats.story: A Precursor field may ignore or redirect an otherwise normal rule for a bounded duration or condition.

disciplines.name: Projectile Weapons
disciplines.story: Kinetic technology should preserve the family’s finite-ammunition, projectile and accelerator identity. Progression can come from launch architecture, ammunition sophistication, penetration/deposition tradeoffs and power efficiency.

lineages.name: Kinetic Main Weapon
lineages.identity: Ship-integrated accelerator weapon. Different accelerator principles can coexist; the gameplay family remains Kinetic when their tactical identity is similar.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Current TL1-TL3 identity is broadly coherent; CP105 encourages naming the launcher/material story instead of generic Kinetic I/II/III.

beats.title: Mature electromagnetic mass driver
beats.story: A rail/coil-like accelerator with conventional smart fire control provides the baseline finite-ammunition main weapon.

beats.title: Improved penetrator/projectile materials
beats.story: The accepted APEN improvement fits better projectile materials/impact architecture rather than a new launcher family.

beats.title: Power-efficient mature accelerator
beats.story: The accepted zero-TP ordinary fire direction fits mature power conditioning/accelerator efficiency while ammunition remains the defining resource.

beats.title: Superconducting coil/induction accelerator
beats.story: Advanced magnets/materials reduce launcher losses and enable new projectile envelopes.

beats.title: Helical/continuous induction cannon
beats.story: An alternate accelerator architecture may trade Space, rate, velocity and wear without replacing mature rails/coils.

beats.title: Smart hypervelocity mass driver
beats.story: Guided/terminal-corrected penetrators and advanced sabot/projectile architectures improve hit/penetration choices.

beats.title: Macron/dust accelerator branch
beats.story: Extremely small high-velocity projectiles create a distinctive saturation/deposition tradeoff and demanding launcher architecture.

beats.title: Field-assisted mass accelerator
beats.story: Inertial/field control permits extreme projectile velocity or compact launch structures while preserving finite projectile packages.

beats.title: Relativistic kinetic lance
beats.story: Pinnacle Kinetic attacks approach relativistic projectile regimes; use strict cost/range/accuracy/collateral constraints to preserve counterplay.

lineages.name: Kinetic Ammunition and Projectile Packages
lineages.identity: Projectile engineering can progress independently of the launcher and unlock specialist packages rather than automatic universal bonuses.

beats.title: Conventional penetrator / fragmentation packages
beats.story: Baseline ammunition differentiates anti-armor versus general damage at the attack-package level if needed.

beats.title: Programmable smart projectile
beats.story: Improved computing enables terminal correction or selectable fuzing without turning every shot into a missile.

beats.title: Dense/graded penetrator package
beats.story: Advanced materials create different APEN/deposition tradeoffs.

beats.title: Micro-submunition/saturation package
beats.story: A single Ammo point may represent a sophisticated multi-body attack package while preserving bounded attack resolution.

beats.title: Exotic dense-matter projectile
beats.story: Very high-density or engineered-matter projectiles are possible high-SF candidates, but material provenance and counterplay need definition.

lineages.name: Kinetic Point Defense
lineages.identity: Local terminal defense using rapid kinetic/projectile interceptors and integrated fire control.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Beam PDS and AMM remain separate branches rather than upgrades that erase kinetic PDS.

beats.title: Rapid-fire kinetic PDS
beats.story: Finite Reaction Capacity and Ammo abstract many physical shots/intercepts.

beats.title: Mature local fire-control / effective-ammo PDS
beats.story: The accepted differentiated PDS maturation can improve Reaction Capacity/efficiency without literal projectile bookkeeping.

beats.title: Guided intercept projectile PDS
beats.story: Smart local rounds improve engagement efficiency and target discrimination.

beats.title: Distributed kinetic intercept grid
beats.story: Multiple mounts/sensors coordinate as one bounded PDS installation rather than multiplying free reactions.

disciplines.name: Energy Weapons
disciplines.story: Energy progression should preserve beam/pulse identity while allowing wavelength/focusing, pulse architecture, distributed directors and particle/ion branches. Not every “energy weapon” needs to share the same damage model.

lineages.name: Coherent Beam Main Weapon
lineages.identity: Laser/beam family whose natural resources are Tactical Power, focusing/track quality and sustained or pulsed energy deposition.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: CP104 shows E3 is a strong robust step. Higher-TL Energy design should be defined in story context before revisiting its numbers.

beats.title: High-energy coherent laser
beats.story: A practical space-combat laser/beam is an intentional slightly-futuristic-to-lower-SF baseline.

beats.title: Improved optics and pulse conditioning
beats.story: Current TL2 may hold combat stats while materials/power integration mature behind the scenes; no forced improvement is needed at every TL.

beats.title: Safe high-output beam mode
beats.story: The accepted Energy High mode is a qualitative power-handling maturation rather than automatic damage on every shot.

beats.title: Short-wavelength / advanced focusing beam
beats.story: Improved wavelength control and optics can extend useful concentration/range independent of raw damage.

beats.title: Tunable-spectrum / free-electron beam
beats.story: A tunable beam trades specialization for adaptability against range, material and defensive conditions.

beats.title: Distributed/phased beam director
beats.story: Multiple apertures coordinate rapid steering/resilience while sharing a bounded output pool.

beats.title: Extreme-frequency beam
beats.story: UV/X-ray-class or equivalent high-energy optics become plausible, with demanding generation/focusing/thermal support and possible radiation side effects.

beats.title: Field-guided coherent lance
beats.story: Science-fantasy field control helps focus/guide extreme beams, but does not grant perfect tracking or infinite range.

beats.title: Pinnacle conversion beam
beats.story: Matter-conversion-era power supports a devastating but bounded beam architecture with explicit power/Strain/charge/counterplay.

lineages.name: Charged-Particle / Ion Beam Branch
lineages.identity: A strong candidate higher-TL branch that can emphasize armor deposition, electronics/radiation effects and specialist defenses rather than behaving as a renamed laser.
lineages.tl1Tl3Reconciliation: Current synthesis leans toward Energy/Beam ownership rather than a new visible research category unless gameplay later proves a separate tree worthwhile.

beats.title: Ion/charged-particle cannon
beats.story: A ship-scale charged-particle accelerator becomes practical once power, magnetic control and thermal support are sufficiently mature. This is the user-cited “Ion Cannon” class of candidate, but the final Star Cluster name/mechanics remain open.

beats.title: Neutralized particle beam
beats.story: Beam conditioning/neutralization improves range/focus and reduces self-dispersion, creating a natural maturation step.

beats.title: Adaptive particle species beam
beats.story: Different particle species/energies could trade material damage, electronics disruption or radiation effects without a universal dose simulator.

beats.title: Relativistic particle lance
beats.story: Ultra-relativistic beams risk erasing ordinary counterplay; keep as a carefully constrained late candidate rather than automatic progression.

lineages.name: Special Energy / Radiation Weapon Concepts
lineages.identity: One-off or rare branches that should be preserved without forcing them into a nine-level sequence.

beats.title: Microwave electronic-attack emitter
beats.story: A long-wavelength emitter may be more useful as electronic attack/sensor interference than hull-damage beam.

beats.title: Plasma cannon
beats.story: Magnetically contained/plasma projectiles are a recognizable higher-SF branch, potentially with strong shield/armor interaction and short effective range.

beats.title: Nuclear-pumped sacrificial laser
beats.story: A reactor/nuclear-coupled one-shot beam is memorable when it requires preparation and consequences; likely Special Weapon rather than normal Main upgrade.

beats.title: Radiation-disruption weapon
beats.story: A specialist attack might threaten crew/electronics or leave contamination, but only after internal/crew mechanics can support it cleanly.

beats.title: Matter-bond disruptor
beats.story: A science-fantasy field/particle weapon that destabilizes material structure. Preserve the concept without committing mechanics or normal-TL placement.

beats.title: Singularity/black-hole gun
beats.story: A Precursor-scale weapon based on artificial singularities or extreme spacetime manipulation is event technology, not a normal player weapon family.

disciplines.name: Missile Weapons
disciplines.story: Missile technology remains modular: launcher/datalink, propulsion/endurance, guidance/seeker and warhead can mature separately. Better guidance must not automatically invent a stronger warhead.

lineages.name: Missile Launcher, Flight and Propulsion
lineages.identity: The delivery system creates finite range/endurance, movement and attack-package behavior.

beats.title: Command-guided missile flight
beats.story: Lower-tech missiles depend on ship track/datalink support and use finite onboard fuel/endurance.

beats.title: Improved propulsion/endurance package
beats.story: A delivery improvement can raise tactical reach or sprint behavior without changing guidance/warhead.

beats.title: Autonomous navigation-enabled missile
beats.story: The accepted TL3 onboard navigation/sensor presence fits qualitative autonomy without weakening Firm terminal requirements.

beats.title: Terminal maneuver / multi-stage propulsion
beats.story: Mature lower-SF missiles trade cruise endurance against terminal sprint/evasion.

beats.title: Cooperative swarm/bus architecture
beats.story: A Missile Flight may represent coordinated submunitions/vehicles with one bounded attack package and richer PDS interactions.

beats.title: High-energy fusion sprint missile
beats.story: Power/Propulsion science creates faster terminal delivery without automatically changing seeker/warhead.

beats.title: Antimatter-catalyzed missile drive
beats.story: Small antimatter quantities produce extreme sprint/endurance at high cost and containment risk.

beats.title: Field-assisted terminal vehicle
beats.story: A science-fantasy missile may use local field manipulation for terminal maneuver, but conventional interception must retain some counterplay.

beats.title: Micro-transition strike vehicle
beats.story: FTL/metric terminal repositioning is potentially game-breaking; preserve only as a late candidate pending movement/interception architecture.

lineages.name: Missile Guidance, Seeker and Counter-Countermeasures
lineages.identity: Target acquisition/discrimination can mature independently of propulsion or warhead.

beats.title: Ship-command guidance / datalink
beats.story: The launching ship provides Firm-track guidance for basic missiles.

beats.title: Onboard navigation and local reacquisition
beats.story: Missile sensors can perform bounded local track improvement while preserving separate command-guided low-tech behavior.

beats.title: Multi-mode terminal seeker
beats.story: A seeker combines modalities and better countermeasure rejection rather than gaining automatic damage.

beats.title: Cooperative seeker network
beats.story: Missile Flight elements share observations or assign targets while maintaining provenance/finite communications.

beats.title: Adaptive anti-jam seeker
beats.story: Higher guidance robustness counters EW through better discrimination and onboard autonomy.

beats.title: Anti-emitter seeker mode
beats.story: A specialist seeker can home on active emissions, creating counterplay to aggressive sensors/ECM.

beats.title: Exotic-field seeker
beats.story: Late missiles may track metric/shield/propulsion signatures when ordinary sensors fail.

lineages.name: Missile Warhead Families
lineages.identity: Payload technology should be modular and may cross-pollinate with Projectile, Energy, Power or exotic branches.

beats.title: Kinetic/explosive conventional warhead
beats.story: Ordinary impact/blast packages remain useful and cheap.

beats.title: Shaped/advanced penetrator warhead
beats.story: Improved material/geometry can change APEN/deposition without changing missile guidance.

beats.title: Nuclear shaped-charge / directed-energy warhead
beats.story: Nuclear payload engineering can create high-energy specialist attacks with strong signature/collateral costs.

beats.title: Fusion microcharge warhead
beats.story: Fusion science supports compact high-energy payloads or pumped effects.

beats.title: Radiation/electronics-disruption warhead
beats.story: A specialist payload may attack crew/electronics rather than structure if internal effects can be represented simply.

beats.title: Antimatter-catalyzed / antimatter warhead
beats.story: Antimatter enables extraordinary payload energy but must reflect production/containment scarcity.

beats.title: Matter-conversion warhead
beats.story: A pinnacle player payload may convert a bounded amount of target/feedstock matter. Require strong defenses/scarcity to avoid universal best-in-slot behavior.

lineages.name: Anti-Missile Missile Defense
lineages.identity: A longer-range guided defensive layer distinct from terminal local PDS.

beats.title: Basic AMM interceptors
beats.story: Guided defensive missiles extend interception beyond local PDS at the cost of ammunition/launch capacity.

beats.title: Mature AMM readiness
beats.story: The accepted TL3 AMM PDS/readiness concept fits this branch.

beats.title: Cooperative AMM screen
beats.story: Networked sensors/launchers coordinate defensive salvos with bounded attempt budgets.

beats.title: Hit-to-kill / extreme-sprint AMM
beats.story: Higher propulsion/guidance improves intercept envelope while maintaining finite reactions and ammunition.

sourceCatalog.title: Star Cluster Game Concept v0.7e
sourceCatalog.use: Authoritative research philosophy, current Power model, mixed-TL/legacy rules and Precursor boundary.

sourceCatalog.title: Expanded Spacedock reference-mining corpus
sourceCatalog.use: Qualitative progression, weapon identity, power/storage/thermal separation, sensors/EW, missiles/PDS, Damage Control, FTL topology, stealth and exotic-tech candidates.

sourceCatalog.title: Checkpoint 23 reference mining and design reconciliation
sourceCatalog.use: Broad-category research, miniaturization, qualitative milestones, separate STL/FTL, KISS/originality guardrails.

sourceCatalog.title: Master of Orion II manual
sourceCatalog.use: Pattern inspiration only: research fields with multiple applications, qualitative unlocks and later miniaturization. No names/tables/ladders copied.

sourceCatalog.title: GURPS Space 4e
sourceCatalog.use: Pattern inspiration only: “taxonomy of miracles,” grounded-vs-superscience tone, drive/gravity/force-field/exotic-resource questions. No mechanics copied.

sourceCatalog.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Technology / Tech List
sourceCatalog.use: Inspiration for enabling-science webs, multiple engineering applications, lower-SF material/computing/power branches. No exact tree/names/stats copied.

sourceCatalog.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Power Plant List / Advanced Fission Systems
sourceCatalog.use: Inspiration that fission/fusion can have parallel specialist architectures and that mature older reactor principles can receive later engineering revivals.

sourceCatalog.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Carbon Nanotubes / Superalloys / Advanced Superconductors
sourceCatalog.use: Inspiration for cross-pollinating material breakthroughs affecting structure, armor, containment, thermal and electromagnetic systems.

sourceCatalog.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Supercapacitors
sourceCatalog.use: Inspiration for storage/discharge-rate progression distinct from sustained generation.

sourceCatalog.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Advanced Heat Management Concepts
sourceCatalog.use: Inspiration for compact radiators and thermal engineering as enabling/support tech rather than a combat heat spreadsheet.

sourceCatalog.title: Terra Invicta Official Wiki - Photonic Computing / Quantum Computing
sourceCatalog.use: Inspiration for qualitative computing-principle changes rather than simple processor-level scaling.

sourceCatalog.title: NASA Space Nuclear Propulsion
sourceCatalog.use: Grounding for fission specialist propulsion branches and mission-dependent tradeoffs between nuclear thermal and nuclear electric propulsion.

sourceCatalog.title: NASA Solar Electric Propulsion
sourceCatalog.use: Grounding for efficient low-thrust electric/ion propulsion as specialist lower-SF technology.

sourceCatalog.title: NASA Fusion Driven Rocket concept
sourceCatalog.use: Conceptual grounding for Fusion/propulsion cross-pollination and direct-energy conversion as an architecture rather than merely a bigger reactor number.

sourceCatalog.title: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory - Fusion Ignition
sourceCatalog.use: Grounding that controlled fusion is an extreme integration/engineering frontier, supporting Early -> Mature -> High-output Fusion story beats.

sourceCatalog.title: CERN - Antimatter
sourceCatalog.use: Grounding for antimatter’s extraordinary energy density plus severe production, vacuum, magnetic containment and handling constraints.

sourceCatalog.title: Miguel Alcubierre - The warp drive: hyper-fast travel within general relativity
sourceCatalog.use: Exotic/high-SF inspiration only; the paper itself requires exotic matter. Not evidence that a practical warp drive exists.

sourceCatalog.title: Crane & Westmoreland - Are Black Hole Starships Possible
sourceCatalog.use: Exotic/Precursor inspiration for artificial-singularity power/propulsion/weapons; explicitly edge-of-possibility theory, not normal technology.
